source.title: Retained source context for Atlantic/coastal geographic extent estimates

documents.title: Tomczak & Godfrey, retained online PDF compilation
NOAA Tides and Currents Glossary, selected current definitions
Philander2001, Atlantic Ocean Equatorial Currents
documents.support: printed188–189; Figure1 original visually reviewed in v1.

method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

sensitivity.interpretation: Route-specific endpoint/drawing sensitivity. Coastal entries can declare smaller or one-sided offshore offsets. These are not physical confidence limits or annual variation; all cases retained.

dateline_policy: Shortest geodesics; continuous display unwrapping and periodic coarse land copies.

currents.scope: Atlantic NECC principal eastward basin reference extent from the North Brazil retroflection/feed sector to the Guinea Current handoff sector.
currents.gate_rationale: 50W8N declares the western feed-sector gate.15W5N declares the Guinea Current handoff; the Guinea coast continuation is excluded.
currents.source_locator: Philander2001 Time-averaged Currents/Figure1, printed188–189; Tomczak/Godfrey Figure14.5, printed236/PDF246.
currents.source_time_convention: July–September surface reference under Philander Figure1. The western surface NECC disappears during part of January–May in that source; this is not a year-round measured extent.
currents.geometry_interpretation: OSW connecting vertices and handoff gates; source definitions/maps are context, not calibrated axis digitization.
not_included: Adjacent named-current extents beyond the declared handoffs
Unmeasured eddy/meander-scale travel distance

currents.gate_rationale: 44W0N is a declared western feed-sector handoff, extending beyond the retained35W observational reach.5E0N stops before island splitting near Sao Tome; downstream branches are excluded.
currents.source_locator: Philander2001 Time-averaged Currents, printed188; retained atlantic-euc-reach-reference-path-candidate source context for eastern bifurcation.
currents.source_time_convention: Schematic thermocline-jet extent; no fixed depth or observation-year axis reconstructed.
currents.geometry_interpretation: OSW connecting vertices and handoff gates; source definitions/maps are context, not calibrated axis digitization.

currents.gate_rationale: 55W40S is the western confluence/turning handoff.12E37S is the offshore eastern turning-sector handoff. Brazil, Falkland, Benguela and Agulhas Return Current lengths are excluded.
currents.source_locator: Tomczak/Godfrey Figure14.2, printed233/PDF243; this is a surface reference, separate from the retained intermediate-depth RAFOS reach.

currents.scope: EACC/Zanzibar principal northward trunk reference extent from the SEC-fed southern sector to a fixed representative Somali-feed/convergence-sector handoff.
currents.gate_rationale: 10S41.5E declares the SEC-feed handoff.2S42E is a representative northern handoff within a source-variable convergence region; it is not a permanent observed boundary. The Somali Current is excluded.
currents.source_locator: Tomczak/Godfrey Zanzibar/East African Coastal Current discussion, printed193/PDF203; Figure11.3 context.
currents.source_time_convention: Source convergence moves between about1N and4S and can cross the equator under different monsoons. The selected2S handoff is a geographic convention, not an annual maximum/minimum.
currents.geometry_interpretation: OSW connecting vertices and handoff gates; source definitions/maps are context, not calibrated axis digitization.
not_included: Adjacent named-current extents beyond the declared handoffs
Unmeasured eddy/meander-scale travel distance
currents.identity_interpretation: Modern EACC/Zanzibar northward flow; not the NOAA East Africa Coast entry that aliases the Somali Current.

currents.gate_rationale: 21.5N69.5W selects the southeastern offshore approach;28N76.5W selects the northern offshore handoff. Upstream NEC and downstream Gulf Stream lengths are excluded.
currents.source_locator: NOAA Antilles Current definition; Tomczak/Godfrey Figure14.2 AC label, printed233/PDF243.

currents.gate_rationale: 60N3E and71.5N23.5E are declared offshore handoffs for this broad name; they are not surveyed endpoints. No neighbouring current length is copied.
currents.source_locator: NOAA Norwegian Current definition; Tomczak/Godfrey Figure14.2 Norwegian C. context, printed233/PDF243.

currents.identity_interpretation: NOAA northeastward off-Norway named-flow convention. No equivalence to Norwegian Coastal, Norwegian Atlantic Slope or Norwegian Atlantic Front Current is established.
